name: T3 Communications
summary: Sydney carrier/wholesale voice + data reseller for SMBs (T3 Communication Partners Pty Ltd group, incl. T3 Communications Pty Ltd; founded 2002, MD Carlos Perez); launched consumer iBurst 'T3 Wireless' retail arm FY2004/05; acquired by Pacific Internet for up to $5m (SPA 31 Oct 2005); T3's ~800 iBurst customers sold to BigAir June 2006.

events.details: Acquired by Pacific Internet (up to A$5m; SPA dated 31 Oct 2005).
